3.label: 3(a)(i)
3.answer: A scalar has magnitude only; a vector has magnitude and direction.
3.explanation: Mass is scalar while force is vector.

3.answer: Kinetic energy is due to motion; potential energy is stored by position or configuration.

3.answer: Mass is measured in kilograms, weight in newtons.

3.label: 3(b)(ii)
